messages.content: Jayden had $70 from selling pictures he took as a hobby.  His sister Ava gave him half of her $90 allowance to help him buy a new camera that costs $200. How much more does Jayden need to buy the camera?

content.text:

Total Jayden has: $70 + $45 = $115

Camera cost: $200

Amount needed: $200 - $115 = **$85**
